verdict.rationale: Loops lets you connect your stack, but only through generic paths: Zapier or Make, incoming webhooks to trigger workflows, and its REST API, SDKs and OpenAPI spec. Any connection to Stripe, Shopify, Segment or a product database would therefore need middleware or custom code. missing for 10: named first-party Stripe/Shopify integrations, a Segment/CDP integration, product-database sync, evidence that integrations are maintained, independent corroboration.
